cases.input: One standard expression references nine rule identities, and one of those rules is also referenced by an expression of a different standard.
cases.expect: The many-to-many non-owning reference is accepted in both directions.
cases.violates: (added:) The expression-to-rule reference is many-to-many and non-owning.

cases.input: A standard expression stores the normative rule text inline and mints a local rule identity.
cases.expect: Both are rejected; rule identity and text stay with the referenced rule boundary.
cases.violates: (added:) The standard expression stores rule references only and never rule text, and never mints a rule identity.

cases.input: A rule reference is replaced inside an in-force expression without issuing a successor version.
cases.expect: The edit is rejected; a prior assessment must stay reproducible.
cases.violates: (added:) A rule reference set changes only by issuing a successor expression version.

cases.input: A registered derogation is authored directly on a standard expression and treated as the waiver of record.
cases.expect: The authoring is rejected; the waiver master is the exception grant.
cases.violates: (added:) Registered derogations are non-mastering projections and may not be authored independently of a grant.

cases.input: A registered derogation slot on a standard expression is dereferenced.
cases.expect: It resolves to exactly one exception grant as a non-mastering projection.
cases.violates: (added:) Each registered derogation must resolve to exactly one Architecture Exception grant.

cases.input: One application holds a live assessment against standard expression v1.0 and another against v2.0.
cases.expect: Both assessments remain valid and neither supersedes the other by existing.
cases.violates: (added:) One subject may hold concurrent conformance assessments against different standard expressions.

cases.input: A criterion outcome is changed from violated to waived because an exception grant is in force.
cases.expect: The change is rejected; the outcome stays violated and the grant is cited alongside it.
cases.violates: (added:) A criterion outcome is never set to waived because a grant exists.

cases.input: Use of a technology recommended by the standard is cited as whole-system conformance.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected; such use is evidence for at most one rule.
cases.violates: (added:) Use of a recommended technology is evidence for at most one rule and never aggregates to a whole-system conformance claim.

cases.input: An effective status of nonconformant with exception in force is requested at an instant inside the grant window, then at an instant after expiry.
cases.expect: Both answers are recomputed from the pinned assessment plus grants effective at each instant, and the assessment outcome is identical in both.
cases.violates: (added:) Effective conformance status is a derived read-only projection with no identity and no master.

cases.input: Effective conformance status is written onto the assessment as a stored field.
cases.expect: The write is rejected; the projection is never persisted.
cases.violates: (added:) Effective conformance status is never persisted on an assessment or a grant.

cases.input: The profile candidate is validated for non-canonical base disclosure.
cases.expect: canonicalPublishable is false and the four pending holds are carried verbatim.
cases.violates: Base specifications and approved relations remain incomplete.

cases.input: A fixture omits violates and closesDefect, and a negative fixture omits expectedCode.
cases.expect: Both fixtures are rejected by the policy's required-field check.

cases.input: A candidate presents four positive and two negative fixtures.
cases.expect: The candidate fails the three-negative minimum rather than passing on total count alone.
cases.violates: (added:) minimumPositiveFixtures and minimumNegativeFixtures are each three.

cases.input: The eighteen prior fixtures are re-emitted under the required schema with assigned codes and unchanged input and expect text.
cases.expect: All eighteen validate, and no prior input or expect wording has changed.
cases.violates: (added:) requiredFixtureFields are enforced on every fixture, prior and additional.
